select.note: Header button that starts choosing several transactions to edit at once.

upcoming.note: Title when the list shows future-dated entries.

reset.title: Reset the list?

body.note: what is a comma-separated list of what narrows the list: "2 filters, an account scope, August 2026".

scope.note: Part of the reset question: the list shows only some accounts.

reset.clear: {count, plural, one {Clear the filter} other {Clear the filters}}

at.note: One converted amount and the rate used.

approx.incomeBody:
{lines}

Converted into {currency} at today''s rate. Everything else in this income total was already in {currency}.
approx.expensesBody:
{lines}

Converted into {currency} at today''s rate. Everything else in this expenses total was already in {currency}.

empty.title: No transactions

hint.note: Why the list is empty; parts are the pieces below joined with commas: "Nothing from Cash, in August 2026, with 2 filters on."

empty.filters: {count, plural, one {with # filter on} other {with # filters on}}

deleteTitle: {count, plural, one {Delete this transaction?} other {Delete # transactions?}}
deleteTransfers: Both sides of a transfer are deleted together.

rates.missing: No rate yet for {currencies}, so it is left out. Connect to the internet once.

due.due: {count, plural, one {# recurring payment due} other {# recurring payments due}}
due.expected: {count, plural, one {# recurring payment expected} other {# recurring payments expected}}
due.waiting: Waiting for the charge to arrive
due.tapMore: Tap to post or skip · {count} more expected

pending.title: {count, plural, one {# pending entry} other {# pending entries}}

selectHintAll: Tap the transactions to change, or Select all

bar.filtersHint: Hold to clear what the list is narrowed to

sum.note: Before the day's total under each day of the list.

entered.note: A payment the bank charged in another currency: the original amount.

returned.note: Part of the payment was returned; both are formatted amounts.

until.note: A range with no start; day is like "22 Sep".

filter.title: Filters
filter.recurringHint: Recurring rows are the ones a rule posted, automatically or after you confirmed them.

tag.note: Stands in for a tag that has been deleted.

tripRangeNow.note: A trip that is still running.

filter.hint: A folder includes all its categories. Several accounts, categories or tags are combined with “or”.
